decisions.reason: Reusing a common website structure with location-specific branding and wording does not change the requirement that each location has its own Wix website.
The source addresses reuse of website structure and does not change the separate Wix account model.
The shared template strategy does not alter how visitors select locations on the master site or are routed to location websites.
The source does not change the master website domain or any domain-to-website mapping.
Common layouts, packages, and prices do not change the requirement for separate revenue, sales, and reporting data by location.
The same-message MODIFY already records the shared layout template across sites; no additional update or removal is required.
The source discusses template reuse and consistent offerings, not payout accounts or payout isolation.
The same source message already introduces both package-catalog and pricing consistency, so no additional MODIFY is needed.
Reusing the website structure does not change separate booking management or the placement of bookings on each location website.
The source does not change the requirement for each location to maintain its own calendar.
A shared website template and consistent prices do not alter the separate payment setup and processing placement for each location.
Copying a common structure across location websites does not change which legacy Harbor Valley content and images are reused for migration.
